top_issues: Primary breakdown bar under total balance combines multiple low-contrast colored dots that compete visually with the action buttons.
fixes: Consolidate balance sub-labels into a single legible card row with higher typographic contrast.

top_issues: Right-hand route and balance breakdown panels create duplicate visual weight against the core input column.
fixes: Demote secondary route details into an expandable accordion beneath the primary fee row.

top_issues: Modal card dims background completely but lacks direct one-click external proof export or explorer link.
fixes: Add explicit 'Export proof' icon action adjacent to the frame verification tag.

top_issues: Oversized pure-white QR code creates severe glare and visual detachment from the dark canvas.
fixes: Frame QR code inside an off-white surface container with integrated token icon badge.

top_issues: Orderbook depth bars and collateral slider overload user before price execution confirmation.
fixes: Group collateral capacity options into a collapsible settings drawer to focus on trade ticket.

top_issues: Subtle multi-segment risk bars require high mental translation without inline labels on track.
fixes: Add micro-labels directly beneath segmented balance tracks showing exact collateral split.

top_issues: Right-side movement inspector is sparse when viewing standard single-hop transactions.
fixes: Expand transaction detail panel to include raw signature bundle and dispute eligibility state.

top_issues: Duplicate screen state with identical visual weight and low distinctiveness from main feed.
fixes: Highlight active row selection state with distinct border accent in feed list.

top_issues: Long scrolling single-column configuration layout mixes visual customization with protocol security.
fixes: Separate bar scale visual presets and key vault management into distinct sub-navigation tabs.

top_issues: From/To matrix tiles look visually identical, making transfer direction ambiguous at a glance.
fixes: Introduce directional connector graphic or distinct background styling between source and target containers.

top_issues: Sparse button grid leaves excessive empty dead space on wide desktop viewports.
fixes: Adopt two-column card structure combining summary metrics directly beside navigation tiles.

top_issues: Faucet controls occupy equal screen real estate as real production account balances.
fixes: Move faucet controls into a distinct collapsible testnet utility drawer.

top_issues: Pool health metrics on right card lack depth regarding utilization and default risk.
fixes: Display historical yield chart and counterparty exposure ratio inside pool stats panel.

top_issues: Extreme negative space with single small configuration card leaves view looking incomplete.
fixes: Center entity ownership topology visualizer showing keys, signers, and threshold states.

top_issues: Action to export dispute evidence is buried at the bottom of technical ledger details.
fixes: Promote 'Save evidence bundle' to top-level action card beside counterparty risk.

top_issues: Dense data table lacks row borders or alternate striping, causing eye drift across long metric columns.
fixes: Add subtle hairline borders between table rows and fix header alignment over numeric values.

top_issues: Command palette items lack shortcut indicators or categorization groupings.
fixes: Group command items into sections (Actions, Navigation, System) with keyboard access badges.

overall.verdict: The interface demonstrates rigorous financial state modeling and consistent technical restraint across views. Complex multi-tier balance concepts occasionally overwhelm standard flows, requiring clearer visual hierarchy.
priority_fixes: Clarify multi-tiered balance headers across screens by standardizing collateral vs credit color indicators.
Add direct one-click cryptographic evidence bundle export from activity details and receipts.
Reduce dead space on desktop settings, ownership, and manage screens via balanced multi-column cards.
Introduce directional visual cues in the Move matrix to prevent source/target confusion.
Separate testnet faucet utilities from production asset balances into a dedicated panel.
